capabilities: Embed local .cast files via an asciinema code block
Embed remote casts using the src: URL prefix
Configure player options like autoplay, loop, speed, and theme
Play recordings interactively with keyboard shortcuts and chapter markers
extras: The player library is bundled into the plugin instead of loaded from a CDN so playback works offline; README explains how to rebuild the plugin to update the bundled library.
problem: Obsidian cannot natively display Asciinema asciicast terminal recordings inside Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: this plugin bundles the entire library directly into its code

summary: Embeds Asciinema terminal recordings (.cast files) in notes via an interactive code-block player with local and remote file support.
